user.title: Light Lifetime
user.description: Track lifetime on-hours, dropouts and age for every light. Lights are discovered automatically, including ones you add later.

data.count_downtime: Count Home Assistant downtime as on-time

data_description.mode: Track all lights and pick up new ones automatically, or track only the lights you pick.
data_description.included_entities: Used in opt-in mode. Only these lights are tracked; new lights are not added automatically.
data_description.excluded_entities: Used in track-all mode. These lights are skipped.
data_description.exclude_aggregates: Skip light entities that represent a group of other lights, such as Hue rooms and zones, which would otherwise double-count their members.
data_description.count_downtime: When Home Assistant is offline, assume lights that were on stayed on. Leave this off to count only time Home Assistant actually observed.

reset.name: Reset counters
reset.description: Zero the lifetime counters for a light and set its first-seen date to now.

entity_id.name: Light
entity_id.description: The light entity whose counters should be reset.

set_values.name: Set counters
set_values.description: Seed or correct the lifetime counters for a light.

on_hours.description: Lifetime hours the light has been switched on.

dropouts.name: Dropouts
dropouts.description: Number of times the light has gone unavailable.

first_seen.description: When the light was first connected.
